title: 教育方法・技術論（情報通信技術の活用を含む）
subtitle: Educational Methods and Techniques
educationalGoal: A good lesson is understood as a Teaching-Learning Process. To make and carry out a lesson as a teaching-learning process, a teacher is needed to have ability to analyze teaching materials and to make a lesson plan. In addition using ICT, teaching materials, making a plan for educational evaluation and improving a lesson are also important. The objective of this course is to acquire methods and techniques for a good lesson.
advice:
This course covers the knowledge and technique which are needed for design and practice of a good lesson as below.
 1. The knowledge which is needed for design and practice of a good lesson.
   1) Teaching: Teaching-Learning process, Teaching theories, corroborative learning.
   2) The elements and requirements which constitute a lesson.
   3) The significance of educational evaluation
 2. The techniques which are needed for design and practice of a good lesson.
   1) how to make a unit
   2) how to make a lesson
   3) how to create a lesson plan
   4) How to use ITC and media
   5) how to make teaching materials
   6) how to make a plan for educational evaluation
books: Ryou Okada, Motoyuki Nakatani, Takamichi Itou, & Shuichi Tsukano(2016) Mizukara Kangaeru Kodomo wo Sodateru Kyouiku no Houhou to Gijutsu. Kitaoji-Shobou.
requiredKnowledge:
●To have taken “Education”, “Educational Psychology” and “Theory of Curriculum”.
●Aiming toobtain Japanese teacher's license.

activityGoals.body: Be able to design a lesson plan with basic knowledge of teacher-learning process.
Be able to create a lesson scenario and explain the significance of the lesson scenario.
Be able to explain how to use ICT and Media effectively in a lesson.
Be able to make a plan for educational evaluation and explain the significance of the plan.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1) Understand teaching-learning theories with historical background and apply them to a lesson plan.

2) Make a lesson plan with adequate learning objectives and proceeding of a lesson.

3) Make effective teaching materials to promote learners’ understanding.

4) Explain the significance of educational evaluation, and make an evaluation plan which matches the lesson plan.

2) Make a lesson plan.

3) Make effective teaching materials to promote learners' understanding.
